about.title: About Top Appliances Repair
about.meta_title: About Us | Top Appliances Repair Houston, TX
about.meta_description: Top Appliances Repair is a Houston appliance repair company: same-day service, a free estimate before any work and a 90-day parts and labor warranty.

faqs.q: Where is Top Appliances Repair based?
faqs.a: Our shop is on South Kirkwood Road in southwest Houston, in the 77072 area. Technicians are dispatched from there across Houston and the surrounding cities.

faqs.q: Do you charge for coming out to look at the appliance?
faqs.a: The estimate is free. The technician diagnoses the appliance at your home and gives you the price before any work starts, and you are free to decline.

faqs.q: What warranty do your repairs have?
faqs.a: Every repair is covered by a 90-day warranty on the parts we install and the labor. If the same fault returns in that period, we come back for it.

All major brands, including Sub-Zero, Thermador, Viking, Bosch, Samsung, LG, Whirlpool, GE, KitchenAid, Maytag, Kenmore, Jenn-Air, Amana, Admiral and Thor. We are an independent repair company and are not affiliated with those manufacturers.
Our work is residential appliance repair in homes across the Houston area. If you are not sure whether your unit qualifies, call us and we will tell you before booking a visit.

faqs.q: How quickly can someone come out?
faqs.a: Same-day service is our standard across Houston and nearby cities when a slot is still open that day. Booking early in the day gives the best chance of a same-day visit.
